definitions.ask: Should the reporter count a late heartbeat as covered when window_s and uptime still match?
definitions.why: window_s/uptime agreement detects lost accounting; a skipped beat (600 s+) cannot fit 450 s

choices.label: Late but fully accounted intervals up to 450 s count as covered and are reported as delayed
The 302 s cap stays, so one late heartbeat on a loaded host leaves coverage INCOMPLETE
